'''Zeek''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]] who sold his wares alongside [[Hyde]] on [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Encounter">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=enemy|Hyde|[[Carrick Station]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Hyde and [[Zeek]] are two merchants that let end-game players get high-level gear. They appear on both Carrick Station and [[Vaiken Spacedock]].

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'' {{1st}}
